title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
summary: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。
summaryEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」與「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" and "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理楔塊」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint wedge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理楔塊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone. Block weight is the basic load for a sliding or falling mechanism. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint wedge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理楔塊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint wedge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。
上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong.
All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
quiz.explanation: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理楔塊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint wedge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint wedge mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 錨索總張力直接相加就是任意方向的支護力。
量到應變後乘上固定模數即可得到精確永久應力。
原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。
optionsEn: Adding cable tensions directly gives support resistance in every direction.
Measured strain times one constant modulus gives exact permanent stress.
Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理楔塊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint wedge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。
knowledge.textEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint wedge mechanism and verification"?
options: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
模型配合一個監測點就證明所有地層參數正確。
optionsEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Matching one monitoring point proves every ground parameter is correct.
quiz.explanation: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理楔塊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint wedge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。
上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating.
All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
quiz.explanation: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩拱應力」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock-arch stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。上覆地層重量提供初始應力量級，實際水平應力及構造作用則可能主導局部壓碎、剝落或高側牆變形。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩拱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock-arch stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩拱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rock-arch stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。
optionsEn: All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement.
quiz.explanation: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩拱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rock-arch stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。
噴凝土表面看起來連續就具有均勻厚度與韌性。
開口率相同的兩個交叉口一定具有相同穩定性。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa.
A continuous-looking shotcrete surface has uniform thickness and toughness.
Two intersections with the same opening ratio have the same stability.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩拱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rock-arch stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分層開挖方案須同時檢查穹頂及拱腳，不可只更新拱頂斷面；側牆開挖停留點由岩洞設計者確認。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
knowledge.textEn: Stage analysis must update both crown and abutments, not only the roof section; the cavern designer confirms hold points for sidewall excavation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。
地下岩洞不受地表搖動，所以支護不用耐震檢查。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model.
Underground caverns do not experience surface shaking, so support needs no seismic checks.
quiz.explanation: 對照覆岩地形與原位應力量測，追蹤穹頂及側牆收斂方向，檢查數值模型的拱腳反力位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare overburden topography and in-situ stress measurements, track crown and sidewall convergence directions, and inspect arch-abutment reactions in the numerical model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩拱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rock-arch stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability.
quiz.explanation: 側牆卸載破壞拱腳拘束時，穹頂支護需求會增加；單看拱頂位移小可能漏掉側向失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sidewall unloading can weaken arch confinement and increase crown-support demand; small crown movement alone may conceal a developing lateral instability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
